currency.basis: The striped-lion knockout mark is what the official site serves today (fetched 2026-10-03); the existing halftone-lion icon is an older variant no longer used by the bank's own presence.

identity.basis: bankofgeorgia.ge JSON-LD and served favicon identify JSC Bank of Georgia (საქართველოს ბანკი); metadata title/country (GE) consistent.

assessment.independenceRationale: Official site bytes (favicon.svg, icon-180x180.png, JSON-LD) fetched first-hand on 2026-10-03; a single web search confirmed the old icon corresponds to the pre-2024 BOG lion style.
uncertainties: The original favicon.svg is monochrome white (dark-ground presentation); the orange colored presentation is officially served only as raster. Candidate preparation must resolve presentation without tracing the raster.

variant.basis: Current standalone symbol variant is the striped lion integrated with the squircle frame; official colored presentation is orange #fc6719 (observed in the served app icon raster).

candidate.detailsJudgement: All emblem details survive: striped neck bands, facial features, paw and tail contours, frame knockout and internal transparency are present in the final render; no lost strokes or satellite details versus the source.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Whole emblem fits the square cell with clearances on all sides at 240px and remains recognizable at 48px on both themes; the white frame is low-contrast on the light theme (same behavior class as the accepted icon's grey frame) but the orange lion carries recognition; source viewBox proportions preserved without stretching.
candidate.rationale: Supported rebranding: the catalog icon is the obsolete halftone-textured lion in a grey rounded-square outline, while the bank's official site currently serves the smooth striped-lion knockout mark (favicon.svg, fetched first-hand 2026-10-03). Replacing with the current official vector restores currency.
candidate.role: Standalone brand symbol: the lion in the squircle-frame knockout, matching the official favicon and 180px app-icon composition (orange lion, white frame, transparent outside).
transforms: No geometry or color transformation: emblem paths and fills are byte-preserved from the original downloaded source (sha256 8f55fca17009c28664b990b7851d937a654562f79f9721ce77ded9270d1843bc); no placement scale/translation was needed.

SVGO 4.1.0 optimization with frozen repo config svgo.config.mjs (sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e): 4271 -> 2779 bytes; selected optimized result (visually identical in rsvg reference renders on both theme canvases; receipt evidence/15636/optimize-1/svgo-receipt.json).
candidate.variant: Current two-tone variant: orange #FF6022 lion with white frame; identical variant and colors to the served favicon.svg and the official icon-180x180.png app icon. No circular-avatar observation exists, so no circular backing was applied; the mark keeps its source transparency (suitable transparent standalone mark).
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Before/after is a clear rebranding difference: halftone-textured lion with spiral eye and grey outline replaced by the current smooth striped lion with white squircle knockout; geometry, texture and framing all visibly change, matching the bank's current official mark.

proposals.reason: Existing icon is an older Bank of Georgia halftone-textured lion in a grey rounded-square outline; the bank's official site currently serves a materially different mark (smooth striped lion in a squircle-frame knockout), so a supported rebranding update is justified.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Supported rebranding: the served original favicon.svg (smooth striped lion, squircle knockout) materially differs from the catalog's older halftone lion with grey outline; replacing with the current official vector.

sources.observation: Official site JSON-LD and served assets identify JSC Bank of Georgia; favicon.svg is the current smooth striped-lion knockout mark (original vector, white fill, sha256 8f55fca17009c28664b990b7851d937a654562f79f9721ce77ded9270d1843bc); icon-180x180.png shows the official orange #fc6719 presentation on dark (raster reference only).
Schema.org-declared logo.png URLs (assets/manifest/logo.png, images/logo.png) return 404/SPA fallback; favicon.svg is the served current vector.
